content.text:
The suite is green now: 2 tests pass, 0 fail.

The test wasn't flaky. It was failing every time because of a real bug. `invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`), but the comment says invoices are dated in UTC. CI runs in Tokyo (UTC+9), so a 23:30 UTC invoice was dated the next day. On a server in a different timezone, real invoices could have been dated a day off.

I switched the three getters to their UTC versions (`getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth`, `getUTCDate`). I didn't skip or change the test.

My first attempt used `sed`, which isn't on your allowed list, so it was denied. I made the same edit with the Edit tool instead.
